title: The Art Gallery on Princess Street
author: Jerry Pinto
description: Kekoo and Khorshed Gandhy gave modern Indian art a window to make a mark around the world. Bombay’s Gallery Chemould was a home away from home for the art community.

title: The Ant and the Cricket
author: Anonymous
description: A poem which provides a moral lesson about hard work and preparation.

title: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
author: Mark Twain
description:
The Adventures of Tom Sawyer by Mark Twain is a popular 1876 novel about a young boy growing up in a small town along the Mississippi River. The story is set in the town of "St
  Petersburg", inspired by Hannibal, Missouri, where Mark Twain grew up. In the story's introduction, Twain notes: Most of the adventures recorded in this book really occurred; one or two were
  experiences of my own, the rest those of boys who were schoolmates of mine. Huck Finn is drawn from life; Tom Sawyer also, but not from an individual—he is a combination of the characteristics of
  three boys whom I knew, and therefore belongs to the composite order of architecture.

title: The Adventures of Supercow (Volume 2 : The Bully)
author: Danielle Bruckert
description:
Supercow is back, this time there is no crime to fight or lives to save, but Supercow does something equally important, defends a small boy from being bullied, and in doing so helps
  the bullies see the error of their ways.

title: The Adventures of Old Mr. Toad
author: Thornton Waldo Burgess

title: The Adventures of Maya the Bee
author: Waldemar Bonsels
description:
The elderly lady-bee who helped the baby-bee Maya when she awoke to life and slipped from her cell was called Cassandra and commanded great respect in the hive. Those were
          exciting days. A rebellion had broken out in the nation of bees, which the queen was unable to suppress.

title: The Adventures of Buster The Bear
author: Thornton Waldo Burgess

title: That's Funny
author: Gabe Fankhauser
description:
A collection of odd rhymes with pictures. Each page makes an exclamatory statement with an observation, often with alliteration. The first page reads, "That's funny! There's a big
  bunny drinking tea with honey."

title: That Night
author: Bijal Vachharajani
description: Chaitu wakes up to loud and angry voices. The night is dark but a fire rages in the distance. Chaitu is terrified for her family, friends and home. Why are these voices so angry? What do they want? A story set in a world fed by fear and intolerance.

title: Tell me...now! : Sweet and Sour
author: Madhav Chavan
description: Learn through interesting questions and answers.

title: Tell me...now! : Happy and Sad
author: Madhav Chavan
description: Learn through interesting questions and answers.

title: Tell me...now! : Good for You
author: Madhav Chavan
description: Learn through interesting questions and answers.

title: Tell me... now! : Round and Round
author: Madhav Chavan
description: Learn through interesting questions and answers.

title: Tell me ... now! : Colours
author: Madhav Chavan
description: Learn through interesting questions and answers.

title: Tell Me, What is a Drone?
author: Shabnam Minwalla
keywords: Tell Me, What is a Drone?
description: A drone flies. It takes photographs, saves wildlife and can rescue people during an earthquake. Would you like to meet a drone?

title: Tara's Treetop Adventure
author: Sangeeta Velegar
description: A tall tale about a girl’s incredible adventure with laughing leaves, squeaky squirrels, and purple planes.

title: Tara finds her Stars
author: Mala Kumar, Manisha Chaudhry
description: Do you like sleeping under the stars? Tara does! Join her as she makes an exciting journey.

title: Tale in red
author: Kostas Stoforos
description:
A fairytale created though facebook, inspired by Stepania Veldemiri’s drawings. Kostas Stoforos saw the first drawing of the girl sleeping, hugging her doll. He imagined a rain of
  peas and the tale… began. Text by text, story following another story, all led the princess without a name to meet the gloomy prince-painter. Their love will turn them to swallows but in the
  ending…

title: Tale in Orange
author: Kostas Stoforos
description:
Marianna loves orange color -and everything with orange color (oranges, carrots etc)- and with a magic turn of events she finds herself in Portokalia. A strange land where
          pianos write fairy tales, the houses have no roofs and you may drink as much orange juice as you like. She will make a new friend and explore this new place…flying! An 'Alice in Wonderland'
          style adventure with lots of imagination, recipes, poetry, and vivid pictures.

title: Swiss Fairy Tales
author: William Elliot Griffis
description: This is a collection of twenty- four delightful Swiss fairy tales by the master storyteller W.E. Griffis, describing the customs, history, and countryside of the Swiss people. Within you will find tales of frost giants, dwarves, fairies, mountain giants, a whimsical avalanche, and much more!

title: Swimming Is Fun
author: Aniek Wijaya
description: It’s time for Sasa’s swimming lessons, but she was having fun playing with Dimas. To her surprise, Dimas wanted to tag along to her swimming lessons. Can Dimas swim? What should Sasa do?

title: Susheela's Kolams
author: Sridala Swami
description: You must have seen kolams on doorsteps at home and even in school, but have you ever seen a kolam in the sky? Read on to find out how Susheela made that!

title: Superhero Day
author: Jo Vosailagi
description: Who is the real superhero? Someone in Class 2 knows.

title: Sun’s Above the Clouds
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description: When it rains, where is the sun? It is still up there even though we can’t see it. The Sun is above the clouds. This story shows how the sun will shine on us again.

title: Sunkeshi: The Princess with Golden Hair
author: Yamuna Parajuli Adhikari
description: Sunkeshi is a kind princess with long golden hair. A monster kidnaps her because he wants to marry her. But Sunkeshi is already engaged to a man she loves. Will she be able to free herself from the monster?

title: Stories from The Arabian Nights
author: Laurence Housman
keywords: Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves
description:
This goregous book includes the following stories as retold by Laurence Housman: Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves; The Story of the Wicked Half-Brothers; The Story of the
          Princess of Deryabar; The Story of the Magic Horse; The Fisherman and the Genie; The Story of the King of the Ebony Isles; The History of Badoura, Princess of China, and of Camaralzaman,
          the Island Prince; Sinbad the Sailor; The first voyage of Sinbad the Sailor; The second voyage of Sinbad the Sailor; The third voyage of Sinbad the Sailor; The fourth voyage of Sinbad the
          Sailor; The fifth voyage of Sinbad the Sailor; The sixth voyage of Sinbad the Sailor; The seventh voyage of Sinbad the Sailor; and Aladdin and the Wonderful Lamp.

title: Stories for Parents, Children and Grandchildren - Volume 2
author: Paulo Coelho
description:
“Stories for Parents, Children and Grandchildren” is a stroll through the universal traditions and legends, lulled by the unforgettable magic words “Once upon a time…” This
          book by Paulo Coelho contains joyful, amazing and dramatic stories for readers of all ages. Most of them recount traditional legends and tales from many cultures. Included are also stories
          inspired by the author’s personal experience and episodes from the lives of celebrated names, as means of reflection.

title: Stick's Masterpiece
author: Spencer Hanson, Randy Hanson
description:
Cute, little Stick learns that while she may not know how to paint a masterpiece, she can do small and simple things. These small and simple things, composed over a lifetime, are
  what become her masterpiece. And the result is more beautiful than she could have imagined. Sometimes challenges can make us feel scared. When we doubt ourselves, we often become too afraid to try.
  The secret, though, is to remember that all great things can only happen one small step at a time. Visit brotherswhim.com for free dowloads of Stick's Masterpiece ebooks and
  artwork.

title: Stick's Adventure
author: Daniel Peckham, Randy Hanson, Spencer Hanson
description:
Cute, little Stick sets off on a grand adventure pursuing big dreams and exciting goals. Along the way she learns that life’s sweetest moments happen along the way. It’s not the
  destination, but the journey that makes the adventure wonderful. Life is a journey worth living. Everyday the small, beautiful adventures await.

title: Starry Skies
author: Sandhya Ramesh
description: We’ve all seen stars in the night sky. But where do they come from? Let’s find out!

title: Sringeri Srinivas's Cow Must Moo!
author: Rohini Nilekani
description: Sringeri Srinivas is back with a new problem. His cow has stopped mooing and he is very angry. The farmer frowns at her. His children feed her sweets. But the cow does not moo. Join this lovable farmer's family and his new cat Manuli, in this tale with a twist.

title: Sringeri Srinivas Learns to Laugh
author: Rohini Nilekani
description:
Sringeri Srinivas was tearing his hair in anger in 'Annual Haircut Day'. He came up with a great idea in 'Too Many Bananas'. In 'Too Much Noise', he found peace. In this book, the
  crazy but lovable, long-haired farmer becomes very, very angry again.

title: Squirrel Goes to School
author: Unknown
description: Trang lives in a mountaintop village with her friend Squirrel. One day, she asks Squirrel to come to school. But school sounds like no fun. And school is so far away. Will Squirrel be brave for his best friend?

title: Spirit of Broo
author: James Palmer
description:
Motivated by greed, Sydney Downe wants to bulldoze a beautiful piece of bushland and turn it into a housing development... Sensing disaster the bush dwellers fight to save
          their homes….. No sacrifice is too great….Will the animals prevail? What will happen to Sydney? Read and listen to this delightful book, adapted from a musical play.

title: Spirit of Broo
author: James Palmer
description:
Motivated by greed, Sydney Downe wants to bulldoze a beautiful piece of bushland and turn it into a housing development... Sensing disaster the bush dwellers fight to save
          their homes….. No sacrifice is too great….Will the animals prevail? What will happen to Sydney? Read and listen to this delightful book, adapted from a musical play.

title: Spincy Spider
author: Herminder Ohri
description: Spincy Spider lived in the thorny bushes. He wanted to be famous. A nice yarn about Spincy and his friends and what it means to be famous.

title: Spice and the Devil's Cave
author: Agnes Danforth Hewes
description:
The setting is Lisbon, Portugal in the late 1490s, as Vasco de Gama, Bartholomew Diaz, and Ferdinand Magellan discuss their plans to find the elusive sea route around the Cape of
  Good Hope, which would enable Portugal to access the spice-rich countries of the Far East.

title: Space Maps - Trek to Mars
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description:
From the Space Port, Captain Ro and crew fly their spaceship into the unknown. They are going where no humans have gone before. They will have to make their own maps on their trek to
  Mars.

title: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
author: Wanda Gag
description:
Snow-White and the Seven Dwarfs is the famous tale of a princess who escapes her jealous step-mother and lives in the woods with seven little men. The step-mother, a witch,
          tries again and again to kill Snow-white. Features elements such as the magic mirror, the poisoned apple, the glass coffin, and the seven dwarfs. Beautifully illustrated, this classic tale
          will capture children's interest and spark their imagination inspiring a lifelong love of literature and reading.

title: Sniffles, the Crocodile and Punch, the Butterfly
author: Herminder Ohri
description: What are friends for, if not to help each other? Even friends like Sniffles the Crocodile and Punch, the Butterfly. A lovely story about two clever friends.

title: Smile Please!
author: Sanjiv Jaiswal 'Sanjay'
description: Follow the young deer as he races along with friends.

title: Smart Sona Helps her Mother
author: Vinita Krishna
description: Sona is smarter than ever. You may have read how she helped her father. This time she finds her mother's work very interesting!

title: Smart Sona Helps Her Mother
author: Vinita Krishna
description: Sona is smarter than ever. You may have read how she helped her father. This time she finds her mother’s work very interesting!

title: Smart Sona
author: Vinita Krishna
description: Sona's father made her a lovely toy. Read this charming story about how they helped each other.

title: Sky-Lings: An Intro to Airplanes
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description:
How did we go from watching birds flapping their wings to flying ourselves? This book highlights this off-the earth adventure. With jet engines and curved wings, we earthlings become
  airborne. Our feet are no longer gravity-glued to the ground. We are Sky-Lings now!

title: Sister, Sister, Where Does the Sun Go at Night?
author: Roopa Rai
description: Little Brother's inquisitive mind is always full of questions for Big Sister. He knows Big Sister has all the answers, because she is always reading one big fat book or another. In this book, Little Brother wonders where the sun goes at night. Does he just go to sleep after a long day at work, or does he sink down into the ocean deep to make it daylight for the mermaids who frolic there?

title: Singing in the Rain
author: Mala Kumar, Manisha Chaudhry
description: Sukhiya Kaka was a famous singer. He met Dinoo who turned out to be his biggest fan. Together they made quite a pair!

title: Shoe Walks - with Funky Fairy
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description:
How can shoes help us understand each other better? What if we had a chance to walk with someone else’s shoes for a day? With the help of Funky Fairy’s magic, a Baker, a Teacher and
  a Mechanic get to do this.

title: Shobhini and Nani
author: Sarvendra Vikram
description:
Little Shobhini loves doing different things. She and her Nani go to the mela, the jungle and even to the moon! A lovely story about Shobhini and Nani's little
  adventures.

title: Shhh...Simmi is Listening
author: Aparna Kapur
description: Simmi knows her sister Lolo very well. She can tell what Lolo is up to even with her eyes closed. Here is a simple book that introduces sound to young readers.

title: Shells and Pebbles
author: Anonymous
description:
Children who were born, and have lived all their lives, in an inland county, scarcely know what is meant by the sea.

Henry Miller was one of these; he was' eight years old, and though he had been taken, when quite a baby, to the sea-shore, he could not recollect anything about it.

title: Sharing
author: Sudhir
description: Rani and Bala are so hungry! But they don't like the food they get. What do they do?

title: Shanti's Friend
author: Deepa Agarwal
description: Do trees speak? That is what Shanti believes. Read this story of an unusual friendship...

title: Shambhu and Me
author: Samidha Gunjal
description: Raavi loves Shambhu, the calf. Come, let's see what Raavi and Shambhu do in the cowshed.

title: Senses - From Sights to Smells
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description: What are our senses? How do they work? Why are they useful? This books helps us: see, hear, smell, touch and taste with senses!

title: Scratch! Scratch! Scratch!
author: Dawa Lahmu Yolmo
description: Manu loves jumping and counting. But trouble starts when she gets the itchy and scratchy chickenpox.

title: Scared for Nothing
author: Hing Sreyrath
description: Sothea is scared of the giant puppet in the village ceremony. What will it do? Is it real?

title: Satya, Watch Out!
author: Yamini Vijayan
description: Jump and crawl and climb with Satya as he goes along with his mother to the farm where she works. A story about the different and wonderful ways in which we move.

title: Sand Sea - Full of Desert Life
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description:
One day Liz accidentally slides down a sand dune. This is the story of the desert plants and animals that Liz learns about on her walk home. The sandy desert looks lifeless and
  lonely but it is actually home to many unique flora and fauna.

title: Sam’s Treasures
author: Jon Keevy
description: What treasures did Sam find in the park?

title: Samira Goes Shopping
author: Bharati Jagannathan
description: Join Samira and Mouchak on their unusual shopping trip!

title: Same-same or Different?
author: Roopa Pai
description: Can you only be friends with people who are exactly like you? Is it wrong to be best friends with someone who is different? SORT OUT the answers to these questions with Snake and Sparrow in this heartwarming story about friendship.

title: Sam and Dina
author: Unknown
description:
This story has been produced for UNESCO as part of its commitment to the FRESH initiative (Focussing Resources on Effective School Health). The story deal with issues such as
  hygiene, sanitation, disease prevention, violence, discrimination and disaster preparedness. Story telling and story writing can not only confirm knowledge and raise interest but also develop a
  whole range of language and life skills and enhance vital attitudes which children need to develop at school.

title: Sabzpari's Jaltarang
author: Shahid Anwar
description:
The village elders believe she sheds green light and plays the jaltarang to bewitch innocent people near the village pond. Kaasni and Faizan decide to investigate if she even exists
  because they don't believe in jadugarnis and paris! This lively play interveaves fantasy and reality with rib-tickling to establish t the importance of a clean environment. Read it and get inspired
  to perform it for hours of fun.

title: Saboo and Jojo
author: Herminder Ohri
description: Jojo and Saboo make a lovely pair!

title: Ruby Red, Rosy Red
author: Jayashree Deshpande
description:
Raju is a city kid who gets most of his fruit out of juice cartons and jam bottles. One day, he gets a chance to visit his grandfather's orchard, where all the trees are full of
  fruit. Join him on his exciting journey of discovery inside this book!

title: Row, Row, Row your Boat
author: Jayashree Deshpande
description:
Visiting Ajja and Ajji in the village is always exciting for Raju, but this time, his grandparents have a special surprise for him. One evening, when they are taking their usual walk
  along the river, Ajja suggests a boat ride. Why don't you join them?

title: Rose and Rocky Go Green
author: Annie Besant
description: Rose has a recipe to turn waste into plant food. Join Rose and Rocky in their adventures in this book about composting.

title: Robin’s First Flight - Wings of Courage
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description: “Robin’s First Flight” is the story of wanting to fly but being afraid to try. Robin overcomes fear and learns to fly! This fable helps each of us find our own wings.

title: Ritu's letter gets longer!
author: Mala Kumar
description: Little Ritu is very eager to see her cousin. So she posts him a very special letter.

title: Rinkitink in Oz
author: Lyman Frank Baum
description:
Meet Rinkitink--a kindhearted king who's as fat and jolly as old Saint Nick himself! When the jovial monarch sails for a visit to the island kingdom of Pingaree, he and his
          talking goat, Bilbil, are welcomed with open arms. Before long, Rinkitink's lighthearted ways and merry songs endear him to the king and queen of Pingaree, as well as to their son, Prince
          Inga. But when the peaceful isle is invaded by fierce warriors, everyone from the rulers to the smallest child is taken off in chains. Only Prince Inga, Rinkitink, and Bilbil escape the
          conquerors. And so the three friends set out--aided by the magical Pearls of Pingaree--to rescue the prince's people.

title: Rilla of Ingleside Anne Shirley Series #8
author: Lucy Maud Montgomery
description:
Anne's children were almost grown up, except for pretty, high-spirited Rilla. No one could resist her bright hazel eyes and dazzling smile. Rilla, almost fifteen, can't think any
  further ahead than going to her first dance at the Four Winds lighthouse and getting her first kiss from handsome Kenneth Ford. But undreamed-of challenges await the irrepressible Rilla when the
  world of Ingleside becomes endangered by far-off war. Her brothers go off to fight, and Rilla brings home an orphaned newborn in a soup tureen. She is swept into a drama that tests her courage and
  leaves her changed forever.

title: Ribbons, lace and dainty shoes
author: Raisa Kirsanova
description: This publication was prepared by the Charity Foundation Institute of Tolerance (Russia) with the help of the UNESCO Moscow Office.

title: Rhino Charge
author: Vijaylakshmi Nagaraj
description:
Ringo, a baby rhinoceros lives in the serene grasslands of Kaziranga National Park along the mighty river Brahmaputra. He is very shy and everybody laughs at him, he he he...! How
  will he make new friends?

title: Reeti and Mithu
author: Anupa lal
description:
Reeti's holidays have begun, but she isn't happy. She doesn't like holidays because she misses being with her friends. One day she gets a pet - Mithu, the talking parrot. Does Mithu
  become her new best friend? Read this heartwarming story of friendship to find out.

title: Real Heroes
author: Otgontuya Badamgarav
description: Turuu and his friend decide to be heroes for a day. What exciting things will they do?

title: Rat king's son
author: Elizabeth Laird, Salim Kasamba, Merga Debelo
description:
How does the greatest king in the world find a suitable wife for his son? (This story was originally narrated by Merga Debelo. The English version was written by Elizabeth
  Laird.)

title: Rat and Goat
author: Ley Sorya
description: Rat loves to play hopscotch but he has no one to play with. His neighbour, Goat, is at home but he prefers to be alone. Can Rat persuade Goat to play with him?

title: Ramya's Stars
author: Mala Ashok
description: Where did Ramya's diamond earrings come from? Find out in this bright little story.

title: Rainbow Valley Anne Shirley Series #7
author: Lucy Maud Montgomery
description:
Anne Shirley is grown up, has married her beloved Gilbert and now is the mother of six mischievous children. These boys and girls discover a special place all their own, but they
  never dream of what will happen when the strangest family moves into an old nearby mansion. The Meredith clan is two boys and two girls, with a minister father but no mother-and a runaway girl
  named Mary Vance. Soon the Meredith kids join Anne's children in their private hideout to carry out their plans to save Mary from the orphanage,to help the lonely minister find happiness, and to
  keep a pet rooster from the soup pot. There's always an adventure brewing in the sun-dappled world of Rainbow Valley.

title: Rain, Rain
author: Sanjiv Jaiswal 'Sanjay'
description: Roll along with the cloud as it brings rain and joy!

title: Rain
author: Nandini Majundar
description:
A golden yellow sun, blazes across the sky, an invitation to grey clouds. Soon they burst open and rain descends accompanied by rain, thunder and lightning. A cool monsoon breeze
  starts to blow bringing welcome relief. Encompassing as it does, two quintessentially Indian elements - with the monsoons in the narrative and the innovative use of zardoshi embroidery for the
  illustrations makes this simple story book strike home.

title: Raggedy Ann Stories
author: Johnny Gruelle
description:
Raggedy Ann Stories, abridged and adapted from the original, contains 13 short stories about the classic rag doll and her friends. The text is accompanied by the original
          illustrations, a picture glossary, and questions to aid comprehension. The language has been simplified for high-beginning level English language learners (with vocabulary at the first
          1000-word level) and is appropriate for young learners.

title: Rabbit Becomes a Chef
author: Chammi Iresha
description: Raw carrots for breakfast. Raw carrots for lunch. Raw carrots for dinner. Rabbit is tired of eating raw carrots and wants to learn how to cook them into a tasty curry.

title: Princess Azzurra and the Gluttonous Dragon
author: Elisa Favi
description:
This is a book for reading and playing.You will help the princess to collect the candies and throw them to an angry dragon, you’ll escape from a maze and reconstruct the pictures of
  all the characters.

title: Pishi Caught in a Storm
author: Mala Kumar, Manisha Chaudhry
description: Pishi was a huge manta ray fish. Once, when he was caught in a big storm in the Indian Ocean, guess who came to his rescue? Dive into this book for a dramatic story.

title: Piggy Wants to Fly
author: Mut Kunthy
description: As Piggy gazes upon a butterfly happy in flight, Piggy dreams of flying. Can Piggy learn to fly like a butterfly?

title: Pig Leads the Way!
author: Irajendran Sevugan
description: All the animals are hungry and the farmer hasn’t come yet to feed them. They decide to feed themselves. And that’s when things get wild!

title: Picture This – Same & Different
author: Unknown
keywords: Activate Games for Learning American English
description:
Same & Different provides students with the opportunity to use their background knowledge about the items on the Picture This cards to create descriptions that compare and
  contrast two items on a card. This game works well groups of 3, having one student select the two items and the other two students alternate comparing and contrasting the two items.

title: Picture This – Questions, Questions
author: Unknown
keywords: Activate Games for Learning American English
description:
Questions, Questions gives students practice forming yes/no questions. Using a Picture This card, a player chooses one item, and the remaining players take turns asking yes/no
  questions to try and guess the item.

title: Picture This – Paraphrase It!
author: Unknown
description:
Paraphrase It! provides students with practice saying the same thing in a variety of different ways by paraphrasing. Paraphrasing allows students to be creative with language to
  express a particular meaning, while practicing different grammatical structures, word forms, and vocabulary. This game works best in groups of 3-4 students

title: Picture This – Mix It, Fix It!
author: American English
keywords: Activate Games for Learning American English
Picture This – Mix It, Fix It!
description:
Mix It, Fix It! allows students to practice creating well-formed questions. First, one player scrambles a question from the Picture This card, and the remaining players work together
  to unscramble it. This game works best in small groups.

title: Picture This – ABCs
author: Unknown
description:
ABCs provides students with vocabulary practice by asking them to think of vocabu­lary words that are related to many different topics. Students use Picture This cards as a starting
  point for each topic. Then they come up with related vocabulary items that begin with many letters of the alphabet. This game works well as a whole-class activity or as a competition among
  groups.

title: Peter Pan In Kensington Gardens
author: James Mathew Barrie
description:
Peter Pan in Kensington Gardens is a novel by James M. Barrie, published in 1906; it is one of four major literary works by Barrie featuring the widely known literary
          character he originated, Peter Pan.[wikipedia]

title: Pendo our cow
author: Ruth Odondi
description: A story about a much loved family cow.

title: Pehelwaan ji learns a slippery lesson!
author: Sanjiv Jaiswal 'Sanjay'
description:
From the earlier Pehelwaan ji books, you may already know that Gappu is not as scared of the big Pehelwaan ji as the others in the village are. Here, Gappu teaches Pehelwaan ji
  another lesson!

title: Password, please?
author: Vahishta Mistry
description: Manju wants to play games on her cousin’s phone. But it’s locked with a password! Here is a book that introduces readers to the concept of passwords as a key to guard information. To find out more, open the book; you don’t need a password for that!

title: Paper Play
author: Mala Kumar
description:
Manju finds a piece of paper. And in the hands of her friends, it becomes so much more than just a piece of paper. Illustrated using bits of paper, so that each page is a collage,
  imagination is at play in this little story.

title: Panda Reads
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description: Learn how to read with the Pandas. See the signs, sounds and sentences behind reading. Open up the wide world of learning as letters become words with meanings!

title: Pambaram the Naughty Top
author: Kavitha Punniyamurthi
description: Spin along with Pambaram, the naughty top, which has a mind of its own.

title: Pakhi the Pigeon
author: Chanchal Sharma
description: Pakhi turns into a pigeon and flies onto a roof. Is this magic or…read more to find out!

title: Ox and Donkey
author: Elizabeth Laird, Salim Kasamba, Melese Getahun Wolde
description: A story about a hard-working ox and a clever donkey.

title: Owners and Appropriators (Nature stories for young readers)
author: Vidya and Rajaram Sharma
description: A story of the struggles and techniques of a few hole nesters.

title: Out and About
author: Agnes de Bezenac, Salem de Bezenac
description:
Greeting people was quite difficult for the character in this short story. He hides behind his parents as shyness takes over. But then a well humored encounter helps him realize that
  it’s not that difficult after all.

title: Our heritage: our pride, our responsibility; explore Nepal's world heritage sites with Fulmaya and Pasang
author: Unknown
description:
The leaflet gives information on the four World Heritage Properties of Nepal that have been listed in the UNESCO'S World Heritage Sites List : two cultural sites- Kathmandu Valley,
  Lumbini, and two natural sites- Sagarmatha National Park and Chitwan National Park.

title: Our Wonderful World
author: Herminder Ohri
description:
God created all kinds of animals and birds. Then he created man who was to be the keeper of the earth. The animals and birds protested so what did God say? Find out in Our Wonderful
  World.

title: Our Swing
author: Akshay Dixit
description: Anuj loves to play on swings. But there are none nearby. His sister has an idea though…read more to find out!

title: Otto Of The Silver Hand
author: Howard Pyle
description:
Otto of the Silver Hand is a children's novel about the Dark Ages written and illustrated by Howard Pyle. It was first published in 1888 by Charles Scribner's Sons. The novel
          was one of the first written for young readers that went beyond the chivalric ideals of the time period, and showed how cruel the time period could really be

title: On the Lap of Mother Earth
author: Mariya Adhikari
description: Earth is like our body with bones and muscles its beautiful like heaven in the world off tussles. Obvious its our beautiful earth of creatures no matter what we need to take care of features.

title: On The Banks Of Plum Creek
author: Laura Ingalls Wilder

title: Old Granny Fox
author: Thornton W. Burgess
description:
Winter's here, and there's a carpet of deep snow covering the Green Forest and the nearby meadow — which means Reddy Fox and Granny Fox are having trouble finding food. Reddy, of course, is full of reckless ideas, such as getting into Farmer Brown's chicken house in daylight.
Using the wisdom she's acquired over the years, Granny overrules many of Reddy's foolhardy suggestions, taking the conceit out of a youngster who thinks he knows more than anyone else. Granny also teaches Reddy quite a bit about patience, common sense, and resourcefulness.
A timeless fable by master storyteller Thornton W. Burgess, Old Granny Fox will delight youngsters with an entertaining story while teaching important lessons — in a painless and enjoyable way — about wildlife, the environment, and personal conduct.

title: Old French Fairy Tales
author: Comtesse De Segur
description:
A wonderful book with 5 timeless French fairy tales magnificently illustrated with 8 beautiful and dramatic full page color and many black and white drawings by Virginia Frances
  Sterrett. "Done when she was only 19 years of age, this was Sterrett's (Chicago born) first book, and she is often referred to as the 'female Kay Nielsen'."

title: Old Chicken Eyes
author: Unknown
description:
This story has been produced for UNESCO as part of its commitment to the FRESH initiative (Focussing Resources on Effective School Health). The story deal with issues such as
  hygiene, sanitation, disease prevention, violence, discrimination and disaster preparedness. Story telling and story writing can not only confirm knowledge and raise interest but also develop a
  whole range of language and life skills and enhance vital attitudes which children need to develop at school.

title: Oh No!
author: Urfa Qurrota Ainy
description: Oh no! Bena wakes up late and needs to get to school very soon. She leaves behind many messes as she gets ready. Will she make it to school on time?

title: Ogs, Zogs and Useful Cogs: A Tale of Teamwork
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description:
Two groups of people compete for survival. The Ogs hunt mammoths. The Zogs individually gather their food from plants. This is a story of confronting conflicts and overcoming
  obstacles. With vision and motivation, people work together to go from famine to feast. Ogs, Zogs and Useful Cogs is a tale about teamwork. Cuisine and climate changes lead to a surprising
  climax.

title: Not Now, Not Now!
author: Rohini Nilekani
description: The little boy in this book wants to do something now, but all his elders say NOT NOW! Do you get angry when someone says that to you?

title: Not Just A Cold
author: Unknown
description:
This story has been produced for UNESCO as part of its commitment to the FRESH initiative (Focussing Resources on Effective School Health). The story deal with issues such as
  hygiene, sanitation, disease prevention, violence, discrimination and disaster preparedness. Story telling and story writing can not only confirm knowledge and raise interest but also develop a
  whole range of language and life skills and enhance vital attitudes which children need to develop at school.

title: No pigs allowed
author: Basilio Gimo
description: This tale explains why pigs have flat noses. What else does the story teach us?

title: No Smiles Today
author: Cheryl Rao
description: Shanti was a happy girl. No one had seen her sad or quiet. Then one day she went very quiet. What had happened to Shanti?

title: Nin Wants to Get Dressed
author: Bounhome Khensonema
description: It's Nin's first day of school. She wants to get dressed in her uniform for school but everyone is too busy to help her! Can Nin get dressed all by herself?

title: Neo finds her pig
author: Sehlopasa Malea LeaASP
description: Neo loses her pig in an accident. What happens after that?

title: Neema's Birthday
author: Godfrey Mishomari
description: Neema loves her birthday, but it takes too long to come. She thinks her parents are playing a trick on her and decides to find out. What does she discover?

title: Naughty Dog
author: Kanchan Bannerjee
description: If you had a tail, you would wag it after reading this book. This book is one of the four books in the 'Animals Around Us' series.

title: Nature's Links of Life
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description:
All around us are atoms on adventures. They join together to make everything on earth: from rocks, to plants and animals and us. Nature flows from elements and into life. The journey
  is brief and borrowed. This is the true story of nature and the links of life.

title: Narmada -A pictorial journey down the river
author: Vidya Shah
description:
An evocative visual journey down the Narmada and through the heart of Central India. Myths and facts combine to capture the essence of life along this beautiful river. Join Aadi and
  Avani as they learn about the special bond that exists between the Narmada and the people who have lived on her banks since centuries.

title: Namu’s bicycle
author: Munanga ASb teachers
description: A monkey rides away with Namu's bicycle!

title: Mystery of the Four Eggs (Nature stories for young readers)
author: Vidya and Rajaram Sharma
description: A tale of how a confusion caused by the Lapwings was resolved.

title: My friends
author: Rukmini Banerji
description: I have many friends. I like all of them but one of them is really special !

title: My fish! No, my fish!
author: Suraj J Menon
description: A funny little story about three friends and three clever fish!

title: My first day at the market
author: Ursula Nafula
keywords: My first day at the market
description:
On Etabo’s sixth birthday, his mother and aunt take him to a faraway town to visit the market for the first time. At the market he has an adventure which eventually ends with a
  wonderful birthday present.

title: My New Color
author: Sekar Ayu Adhaningrum
description: Alma’s father doesn’t let her do what she wants because she is a girl. When Alma asks to repaint a wall in her room, he says that he and Alma’s brother will do it for her. Will Alma get to make her room look the way she wants?

title: My Father's Dragon
author: Ruth Stiles Gannett
description:
Elmer Elevator (narrator's father as a boy) runs away with an old alley cat to rescue a flying baby dragon being exploited on a faraway island. With the help of two dozen
          pink lollipops, rubber bands, chewing gum, and a fine-toothed comb, Elmer disarms the fiercest of beasts on Wild Island.

title: My Family
author: Arshi Naaz, Sushila, Kuldeep Sandhu
description: Come and meet my big family.

title: My Colourful Pencils
author: Maasoumeh Ansarian
description:
Nobody played with the little girl. Mammy was busy in the office and kitchen. Daddy read the newspaper and her brother did homework all the time. Some colourful pencils were ready to
  play with the little girl. They helped her draw her mammy, daddy and her brother and they all liked the paintings! Now her brother wants to draw with her!

title: My Bodyguard
author: Janaki Sooriyarachchi
description: A little boy takes care of, and becomes good friends with a dog he names Yappy. Yappy is a true friend and protects the little boy from danger.

title: My Best Friend
author: Anupa Lal
description: Would you like to have a very special friend? Look into this book and you may find that you already have a very special friend!

title: My Balwadi
author: Rukmini Banerji
description: Children always like to share their experience with others. 'My Balwadi' shows how enjoyable that can be.

title: Munni, the Lamb
author: Chayadatta Nyupane
description: Mother Goat has given birth to two new kid goats! What do they do?

title: Mumtaz Embroiders Her Dreams
author: Jolly Rohatgi
description:
Young Mumtaz has come from her village to Lucknow to learn new stitches for the chikankari that she and the other women in her village do. Thanks to her friend Munnu, Mumtaz learns
  even more than she had imagined! Jolly Rohatgi's sensitive story is illustrated by Ram Soni through sanjhi, the art of paper cutting.

title: Mummy's Glasses
author: Tanu Shree Singh
description: Mummy has lost her glasses again! It’s up to Nimu and Mirchi to find them. But what else will they find on the way?

title: Muchkund and his Sweet Tooth
author: Madhav Gadgil
description:
Bears, bees and blossoms are three enchanting building blocks of our natural world. The Indian rock bee is a giant bee because it is one of the biggest honeybees in the
          world. Rock bees forage by moonlight. Scientists have been working with forest dwellers to safeguard rock bees, a precious natural heritage. In this informative tale, Muchkund and his
          bright gang of ghosts have a clever way of dealing with the burning issue of forest offenders!

title: Mrs Peter Rabbit
author: Thornton Waldo Burgess
description:
Something is definitely wrong with Peter Rabbit . . . he has no appetite! Deciding he is terribly lonely, Peter sets off to visit some friends in the Old Pasture but instead finds
  himself narrowly escaping the clutches of Hooty Owl, experiencing a nasty encounter with Jed Thumper (a big gray rabbit) and eventually staring right into the soft, gentle eyes of Miss Fuzzytail.
  Before you know it, Peter has a new bride! Children will love sharing the adventures of Mr. and Mrs. Peter Rabbit as they start a new ― and often precarious ― life together in the Dear Old
  Briar-Patch. As they enjoy the story, youngsters absorb gentle lessons about nature, wildlife, and simple human virtues. Eight charming new illustrations, based on the originals by Harrison Cady,
  enhance this delightful tale, newly reprinted in large, easy-to-read type.

title: Mrs Penguin’s Perfect Palace
author: Helen Brain
description: The Penguin family lives on the beach, surrounded by rubbish. Until one day, Mrs Penguin says: we need a house! But how will they build one?

title: Mr. Anand has an Adventure
author: Mala Kumar, Manisha Chaudhry
description: Mr. Anand loves to go walking in new places. Every outing is an adventure to him. This time he thinks he has learnt a new language. Do you also think so?

title: Mouse in the House
author: Sowmya Rajendran
description: A mouse enters the house. And there is utter chaos. Here is an action-packed adventure for little ones

title: Moonlight in the Sea
author: Kartik Shanker
description:
Fatima grows up on an idyllic island in the Lakshadweep, watched over by Nihla, the moon. She falls in love with the underwater world of colourful corals, fascinating fish, mysterious manta rays, grizzled old turtles and dancing dolphins. One day, in a terrible storm, she gets lost at sea. Join Fatima on her incredible adventure on remote islands with wonderful marine creatures.
children

title: Moo Moo Brown Cow, Have You Any Milk?
author: Jayashree Deshpande
keywords: Moo Moo Brown Cow, Have You Any Milk?
description:
Does milk come out of a packet or out of a cow? When city boy Raju visits his Ajji's farm in the village, he watches Ajji milking her cows. Raju loves the sight of the fresh milk
  frothing in the bucket, but there is something he enjoys even more. What do you think it is?

title: Monkey Star -Practice Before Play
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description: Mo walks on stage without knowing how to play the guitar. As you can imagine, this do not go well. Later, Mo learns that playing takes lots of practice.

title: Monkey Eats his Own Tail
author: Mozambican folktale
description: That rabbit is at it again!

title: Mom's Red Coat
author: Chrissie Kritzinger
description: Mom needs to go away for work. I’ll miss her. Will it help if she leaves her red coat with me?

title: Mod the Toad
author: Alice Mulwa
description: This is the tale of why toads have bumpy backs and hide in cool, dark places.

title: Miss Tiny Chef
author: Linda Nabasa
description: Miss Tiny Chef is only eight years old. She does things other little girls wouldn’t do. Armed with a talking mingling stick that shares all its great recipes with her, Kasini stirs up a special surprise meal for mummy.

title: Miss Laya's Fantastic Motorbike Carries a Big Box
author: Mala Kumar
keywords: Miss Laya's Fantastic Motorbike Carries a Big Box
description: Miss Laya the Games Teacher loves helping people! Join her and her fantastic motorbike as they vroom off with a mysterious box this time around. This is the third in a series of stories called Miss Laya'sFantastic Motorbike.

title: Meerkat Magic
author: Tumisang Shongwe
description: Bonke and Peo don’t know what’s at the top of their favourite hill. What will they find if they’re brave enough to climb it?

title: Meera and Ameera
author: Nimmy Chacko
description: Ameera is Meera’s best friend. Strangely, nobody else can see her. That’s because Ameera happens to be an imaginary porcupine. Join the two friends on their many adventures, real and made-up.

title: Meena Series: When Meena Was A Little Girl
author: Unknown
description:
Meena is a little girl who lives in a village with her parents, her grandmother, her brother Raju and her baby sister, Rani. Mithu, the parrot, is her best friend. In many
          ways, Meena is like any other little girl you know. But in some ways she is completely different. She is friendly but is not afraid to ask questions. Share in Meena’s adventures as she
          laughs, climbs trees, asks questions and solves problems, and shows you all the things that a little girl can do. This story highlights how to deal with low birth weight among infants and
          its prevention.

title: Meena Series: Too Young To Marry
author: Unknown
keywords: Meena Series: Too Young To Marry
description:

description:

description:

description:

author: Unknown
description:

author: Unknown
description:

title: Me Too ...
author: V. Suteyev
description: A newly hatched chick is following a duckling… Do they get into trouble? Beautiful and warm illustrations enliven the story.

title: Matthew is up!
author: Nicole Copley
description: Matthew wakes up with the sun. But he is the only one!

title: Manu Mixes Clay and Sunshine
author: Bulbul Sharma
description:
Manu's father and grandfather are potters, and Manu is learning the craft. This lively story depicts both the simple joys and the hardships of a potter's life, from gathering clay
  and making pots to selling them in the city markets. Bulbul Sharma's enchanting story is illustrated by Shanti Devi in the Madhubani style.

title: Manikantan Has Enough
author: Anil Menon
description:
Manikantan's Amulet can tell when he's happy or sad, sick or well. It can tell him when to eat, help with his homework and let Amma know if he's not feeling well. Is it magic or is
  it science? Find out what happens when Manikantan and his mother move to the Smart City from their village.

title: Mangalyaan: A Journey to Mars
author: Nikhil Gulati
description: Hop aboard the spaceship called Mangalyaan. Our destination is Mars. We will fly past the Moon and journey to the other side of the Sun. Let’s go.

title: Making Friends with Snakes (But from a Distance)
author: Rohan Chakravarty
description: Naagin and Dhaman are here to make friends with you, but from a distance. After all, they are snakes. Find out everything you wanted to know about these beautiful reptiles and also learn how to stay safe and let snakes slither to safety!

title: Make Way for Ducklings
author: Robert McCloskey
description:
This is the story of Mr. and Mrs. Mallard, a pair of ducks. They are on the look out for a safe place to raise their family. They finally find a place on the banks of a river in
  Boston. The story also describes the great walk of Mrs. Mallard and her ducklings across the city to the public garden where they decide to stay. Contributed by: Arvind Gupta

title: Magic for Beginners
author: Charles Dickens
description:
Link's engaging and funny second collection -- call it kitchen-sink magical realism -- riffs on haunted convenience stores, husbands and wives, rabbits, zombies, weekly
          apocalyptic poker parties, witches, superheroes, marriage, and cannons -- and includes several new stories.

title: Maaloo, Kaaloo ...and who?
author: Vinita Krishna
description: Maaloo and Kaaloo are back! This time they are playing detective at Grandma's house in the hills.

title: Ma! Hurry Up!!
author: Rukmini Banerji
description: The boy in the story is in a real hurry. Wouldn't you like to find out why?

title: Lost and Found
author: Sukhada Rahalkar
description: A little boy looks for something he has lost and guess what happens when he finds it? Read on to find out for yourself.

title: Look out, Luthando!
author: Sue Boucher
description: Luthando is very good at listening and very good at smelling, but he’s not so good at looking where he is going. He walks into puddles and bumps his head. What could be the problem?

title: Look at me
author: Pankaj Chaturvedi
description: Meet the children in the book. They are just like you!

title: Look Closer
author: Irawati Subrata
description: Everything is blurry! Kirana can’t see clearly. Everything is different now. No longer can Kirana freely study, go to school, play, or even do her favorite puzzle. What's happened with Kirana? How will Kirana get through her days?

title: Lonwabo's Recipes
author: Mihlali Kumalo
description: Lonwabo loves helping grandmother grow vegetables to make delicious meals for the family. He dreams of opening a restaurant one day and cooking just like his granny.

title: Little Monkey's Lost Bananas
author: Long Leapsocheata
description: Little Monkey’s home is always messy. One day, Little Monkey feels hungry but his house is so messy that he cannot find his bananas to eat! He asks the other animals in the forest if they've seen his bananas. Do you think the other animals can help Little Monkey find his lost bananas?

title: Little Men: Life at Plumfield With Jo's Boys
author: Louisa May Alcott
description:
Little Men, or Life at Plumfield with Jo's Boys, is a novel by American author Louisa May Alcott, first published in 1871. The novel reprises characters from Little Women and is
  considered by some the second book in an unofficial Little Women trilogy, which is completed with Alcott's 1886 novel Jo's Boys, and How They Turned Out: A Sequel to "Little Men". It tells the
  story of Jo Bhaer and the children at Plumfield Estate School. It was inspired by the death of Alcott's brother-in-law, which reveals itself in one of the last chapters, when a beloved character
  from Little Women passes away. It has been adapted to a 1934 film, a 1940 film, a 1998 film, a television series, and a Japanese animated television series.

title: Little Lord Fauntleroy
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
description:
Little Lord Fauntleroy (1885, 1886) by Frances Hodgson Burnett is a beloved children's novel that made a huge impact on the 19th century public, shaping everything from boys'
          clothing fashions to copyright law. Cedric Errol is a generous, kind, and exemplary middle-class American boy who is suddenly found to be the heir of the Earl of Dorincourt. Saying loving
          goodbyes to his working-class friends, Cedric goes to England together with his mother to embrace his new fortune. His grandfather, the old earl, is a bitter old man ridden with gout and a
          foul temper, trusting no one. However the angelic boy elicits a profound transformation in the grandfather, which not only benefits the castle household but the whole populace of the
          earldom. If only the old man's heart would soften toward Cedric's estranged mother, the family would be healed at last. And when another potential heir to the earldom makes a claim, it
          seems that everything is lost.... But all things are possible through a child's innocent trust, true friendship, and unconditional love.

title: Little Brother
author: Cory Doctorow
description:
Little Brother is a novel by Cory Doctorow, published by Tor Books. It was released on April 29, 2008. The novel is about several teenagers in San Francisco who, in the aftermath of
  a terrorist attack on the San Francisco – Oakland Bay Bridge and BART system, defend themselves against what they see as the Department of Homeland Security's attacks on the Bill of
  Rights.--http://en.wikipedia.org

title: Lions Are Always Brave
author: Daniel Browde
description: This little lion wants you to know that lions are strong, fast, and most of all, brave. But what is that storm cloud on the horizon? A story about who we are and who we think we should be.

title: Lilith
author: George Macdonald
description:
Lilith is a fantasy novel written by Scottish writer George MacDonald and first published in 1895. Its importance was recognized in its later revival in paperback by
          Ballantine Books as the fifth volume of the celebrated Ballantine Adult Fantasy series in September 1969.

title: Let’s Play Together, Dad!
author: Nurhayati Pujiastuti
description: Dad experienced a bad accident. Since then, he has been feeling gloomy. Niken wants to cheer Dad up so they can play together again.

title: Let’s Be Friends
author: Murray Hunter
description: Making friends isn’t always easy. But let’s try!

title: Letter to mum
author: Ursula Nafula
description: A mother is going to hospital to give birth and her daughter writes her a letter.

title: Let's Play
author: Meethil Momaya
description: Ready, set, go...Learn the science behind play.

title: Let's Go Seed Collecting!
author: Neha Sumitran
description: Join Tooka, Poi and their best friend Inji the dog as they go around collecting seeds. The adventure begins when the three friends meet Pancha the Tamarind Tree.

title: Legend of the Red Moon
author: Asmaa Emara
description: The moon has turned red and the people in Jimmy’s village are afraid. Can Jimmy help his grandfather and the villagers understand what is happening to the moon?

title: Lebo and Gogo's Tea Party
author: Siphosethu Zantsi
description: Lebo is excited to have a day of adventure with Gogo. When Gogo hurts herself, she can’t do anything that Lebo wants to do. What can Gogo and Lebo do to have fun together?

title: Lara's Stories
author: Amro Abu-Hmaidan, Israa Magdy
keywords: Lost in the Mists of Time
description: Lara lives in a small village that is far from anylarge city. Everyone lives just as they have forhundreds of years. Nothing ever changes, andmost people are happy to keep things the waythey are.But Lara is a curious girl. She wants to knoweverything and dreams of learning about theworld outside her village.

title: Lara the Yellow LadyBird
author: Martha Evan
description: A yellow bug in a world of red, Lara the Ladybird just wants to fit in.

title: King Solomon's Mines
author: Henry Rider Haggard
description:
King Solomon's Mines (1885) is a popular novel by the Victorian adventure writer and fabulist, Sir H. Rider Haggard. It tells of a quest into an unexplored region of Africa
          by a group of adventurers led by Allan Quatermain in search of the missing brother of one of the party. It is significant as the first English fictional adventure novel set in Africa, and
          is considered the genesis of the Lost World literary genre.

title: Kick, Start, Go!
author: Nikhil Gulati
description: Have you ever wondered how a motorcycle works? It all begins with a kick!

title: Kato Clever And The Big Trouble
author: Herminder Ohri
keywords: Kato Clever And The Big Trouble

title: Katiiti’s Song
author: Philippa Namutebi Kabali-Kagwa
description: Every day, Katiiti’s mother calls her with a beautiful song. One day, a crafty gorilla tries to sing as sweetly as her mother.

title: Kallu's World 4 - Hero Horoscope Man
author: Subhadra Sen Gupta
description:
Welcome to Khajuria-a village where young Kallu and his gang run delightful adventurous riots almost everyday. Sometimes they question village traditions, defy bullies or just go
  about their daily business, but Kallu and his gang are up for anything. Join them as they grow wiser and wittier, happily roaming the village finding new things to do, and see what they come up
  with! A world renowned 'Astrologer- Palmist- Tantra Expert- Futurologist- Numerologist... etc' is visiting the village. What could he predict other than the future... class test questions perhaps?
  Or perform a few magic tricks? What happens when Kallu's gang decides to check out the 'horoscope man'? No need to go to an astrologer to find out. Just read on...

title: Kallu's World 3 - Mangu Mali and the Ambia Bhoot
author: Subhadra Sen Gupta
keywords: Mangu Mali and the Ambia Bhoot
description:
Welcome to Khajuria- a village where young Kallu and his gang run delightful adventurous riots almost everyday. Sometimes they question the village traditions, defy bullies or might
  just be going about their daily business but Kallu and his gang are up for anything. Join them as they grow wiser and wittier, happily roaming the village finding new things to do, and see what
  they come up with! Everybody in Khajuria knew about Munia's temper. Everybody also knew how stingy Mangu Mali was about giving away mangoes &om the tree in his orchard. Now, Munia wanted
  mangoes ••. really badly and that too &om Mangu Mali's orchard. Can you imagine a situation like this? Read on, to find out what happens ..•

title: Kaldi and the Dancing Goats
author: Svay Leemeng
description: Why are Kaldi's goats excited and dancing around? Learn about the legend of Kaldi and his dancing goats.

title: Kachi-Kachi Mountain
author: Unknown
keywords: Griffith Farran & Co., London and Sydney
publisher: Griffith Farran & Co., London and Sydney

title: Jumpy the Germ
author: Unknown
description:
This story has been produced for UNESCO as part of its commitment to the FRESH initiative (Focussing Resources on Effective School Health). The story deal with issues such as
  hygiene, sanitation, disease prevention, violence, discrimination and disaster preparedness. Story telling and story writing can not only confirm knowledge and raise interest but also develop a
  whole range of language and life skills and enhance vital attitudes which children need to develop at school.

title: Joy
author: Pankaj Chaturvedi
description: You can find joy in simple things. Read this story and you will know how...

title: Jordan and the Little Magic Pencil
author: Anna Kondis
keywords: Jordan and the Little Magic Pencil
description:
Through this fairytale “Jordan and the Little Magic Pencil” children will realise that language and dictation are like a game. Parents and teachers should help them understand the
  magical world of language, unlock it, and love it. In this effort little Jordan will be their assistant.

title: Joongedai's Things
author: Niraj Balami, Balkoseli Group
description: Joongedai does not keep his room clean. His belongings are scattered all over the place. All his things are angry with him for not keeping them in the right places. They feel unwanted and neglected. How will they convince Joongedai to keep his room more neat?

title: Johnny Crow's Party
author: L. Leslie Brooke
description: Johnny Crow plies rake and hoe to improve his garden. The other animals all come to his party and leave with a hearty vote of praise.

title: Joanna’s Grannies
author: Dawn Garisch
description: Joanna has two grannies. They are very different but they both love her the same.

title: Jadav and the tree-place
author: Vinayak Varma
description: Jadav has the best job in the world: he makes forests! How does he do it? Read this book to find out!

title: Jackal and Rabbit
author: Jacob Kono, Elizabeth Laird, Mohammed Kuyu
description:
Rabbit saves Jackal from a difficult situation. But instead of fulfilling his promise to reward Rabbit, Jackal changes his mind. (This story was originally narrated by Mohammed Kuyu.
  The English version was written by Elizabeth Laird)

title: Jack and Jill
author: Louisa May Alcott
description:
When best friends, Jack and Jill, tumble off their sled, their injuries cause them to be bedridden for many months. Their parents fill their days with the joys of Christmas
  preparations, a theatrical production and many other imaginative events.(Goodreads)

title: It’s Amma’s birthday, tomorrow
author: Janaki Sooriyarachchi
description: The story of a little girl named Nikini who tries to find the prefect gift for her mother on her birthday. Read the book to find out what she gives her mother.

title: It's a Ghost!
author: Chandan Yadav
description: Once there was a ghost who loved to scare someone every day. One day, he decided to look for something easy to scare… like a mouse! Will the mouse be as frightened as everyone else?

title: It's Like This, Cat
author: Emily Neville
description:
"My father is always talking about how a dog can be very educational for a boy. This is one reason I got a cat." Dave Mitchell and his father yell at each other a lot, and
          whenever the fighting starts, Dave's mother gets an asthma attack. That's when Dave storms out of the house. Then Dave finds Cat, a stray, and adopts him. On his outings with Cat, Dave
          meets new friends and learns a lot about himself and his father. Winner of the 1964 Newbery Medal.

title: Is This My Home?
author: Sean Henrick Moore
description: A little girl travels far and wide in search of her home.

title: Is There Anyone Like Me?
author: Fred Strydom, Stephen Wallace, Jess Jardim-Wedepohl
description: I wonder if there’s another me somewhere in the world…

title: Irish Fairy Tales
author: William Butler Yeats
description:
I am often doubted when I say that the Irish peasantry still believe in fairies. People think I am merely trying to bring back a little of the old dead beautiful world of romance
  into this century of great engines and spinning-jinnies. Surely the hum of wheels and clatter of printing presses, to let alone the lecturers with their black coats and tumblers of water, have
  driven away the goblin kingdom and made silent the feet of the little dancers. Old Biddy Hart at any rate does not think so. Our bran-new opinions have never been heard of under her brown-thatched
  roof tufted with yellow stone-crop. It is not so long since I sat by the turf fire eating her griddle cake in her cottage on the slope of Benbulben and asking after her friends, the fairies, who
  inhabit the green thorn-covered hill up there behind her house.

title: Inside the World Wide Web
author: Roopa Rai
description: Gather around to listen as our bright friend Nettikutti unravels the magic and mystery of the ginormous digital brain called the world wide web.

title: Inku Chomps, Gobbles and Slurps
author: Raji Sunderkrishnan
description: Flying food, crawling food, hopping food – no food is too crazy for Inku! Join Inku on her food adventures as she meets other creatures of the forest.

title: In the Land Where Beetles Rule
author: Suniti Namjoshi
description: What would happen if the beetles were in charge? Or if fish ruled the world? This fantastical poem offers a powerful glimpse into worlds where nature comes first.

title: In Open Sea
author: Ivan Parvov
description:
Bubu's back in another amazing tale. When Bubu finds a bottle in the sea with a call for help inside it is clear for everyone – a new adventure awaits. And this time he is not alone
  – his friends Oskar and Rico are coming with him. What lies ahead? Fearful sharks…a powerful storm…a sinking ship…and a new friendship. One thing is for sure – no one will remain dry in this
  amazing sea quest.

title: Images in Action: Why Movies Move
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description:
This book is about the story behind the motions in movies. It is an epic adventure from silent, still, Black and White films to the colorful movies of today. That is our cue. Let’s
  get started. Ready the light sensitive silver, set the cameras and of course go with lots of ACTION!

title: I'm the Colour of Honey
author: Maïmouna Jallow
description: Is that your teacher? Is that your Aunty? Amanda is fed up with these questions and wishes that she looked just like her Mummy and Daddy. But maybe they are more alike than she realises!

title: I enjoy doing
author: Ursula Nafula
description: Short simple sentences about things a child enjoys doing.

title: I don't want to go to sleep!
author: Sarah McGregor
description: Nandi doesn’t want to go to sleep. No way! She wants to go on an adventure. Join Nandi as she lets her imagination run wild and free.

title: I can do this
author: Zanele Buthelezi, Clare Verbeek, Thembani Dladla
description: This picture book describes activities that we learn to do as we grow up.

title: I Was Walking Down the Road
author: Sarah E.Barchas
keywords: I Was Walking Down the Road
description:
I Was Walking Down The Road is another book for young children. Repeated usage of sentences with the same structure makes the book a good resource for language teaching. More than
  that, the storyline is in itself well worth exploring with children. Contributed by: Arvind Gupta

title: I Need a Violin
author: Aruna Keerthi Gamage
description: A dragonfly wants a violin but does not know how to make one. His friend the butterfly helps him get a violin.

title: I Know My Rights
author: Menaka Raman
description: The United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child lists out the basic rights that children have. It doesn’t matter where you come from, what color your skin is, whether you practice a religion or not, what language you speak, whether you are a boy or a girl or haven’t decided yet – you have the right to these rights! This poster books lists out some of the rights of the child.

title: I Have So Many Friends
author: Rama Hardeekar-Sakhadeo
description: Akash has many friends. Four-legged, moving on wheels, green coloured, those that show him the magic of words...Who are all these friends?

title: I Had A Flower
author: Unknown
description:
This story has been produced for UNESCO as part of its commitment to the FRESH initiative (Focussing Resources on Effective School Health). The story deal with issues such as
  hygiene, sanitation, disease prevention, violence, discrimination and disaster preparedness. Story telling and story writing can not only confirm knowledge and raise interest but also develop a
  whole range of language and life skills and enhance vital attitudes which children need to develop at school.

title: I Don't Want to Eat!
author: Unknown
description: Clarita wants to be a superhero, but she needs super power. What can Clarita do?

title: I Can Help!
author: Mini Shrinivasan
description: A big girl or boy can help others in many ways. Helping is so much fun! This book is one of the four books in the 'Growing Up' series.

title: I Am Not Scared Of The Rain
author: Unknown
description: It’s a rainy day and Cat and Dog are going to school. What will happen if Dog refuses to take an umbrella?

title: Hyena and Raven
author: Ann Nduku
description:
Hyena wants to know what the white thing is round Raven’s neck. On hearing that it is meat, he does everything to go up into the clouds to get this 'meat'. He falls and gets the
  spots he has to date and his friendship with Raven is ended.

title: Hungry jackal and the sour grapes
author: Kholeka Mabeta
keywords: Hungry jackal and the sour grapes
description:
A hungry jackal comes across an orchard where a ripe bunch of grapes is hanging from a branch. The jackal jumps up to grab the grapes but he falls hard on his back. He keeps jumping
  even higher and each time he falls even harder on his back. Will he ever get the grapes?

title: Humi Bird - A Humble Tale
author: Douglas J Alford, Pakaket Alford
description: Humi Bird learns that you can only fly while not watching your own wings.

title: How to Tell the Birds from the Flowers
author: Robert Williams Wood

title: How is Bimala's Cake So Spongy?
author: Vidya Pradhan
keywords: Why is Bimala's Cake So Spongy?
description: Chinni and her father bake a cake for her friend in their bakery. Why are cakes so spongy? What makes them rise? Come, let's find out.

title: How do you sleep?
author: Diane Awerbuck
description: Can you sleep with one eye open? Can you sleep in a tree? Pula has a bed, but he wants to know how other creatures sleep.

title: How You Began
author: Amabel Williams-Ellis
description:
I think this a good book. I know of no book like it. All girls and boys should know how they grew. I did not know this when I was quite young. Now I wish I had. But there was
          no book like this then. I wish there had been. I have to teach people who are going to be doctors. I should find it much easier if they had read a book like this when they were children.
          Besides it is such fun to know that you once played at being a fish, and later had fur. How I wish I had kept my gills and my fur coat. Then I should not have to dress or to learn how to
          swim. And I am sad I have lost my nice tail. And this book tells how some of the children’s children of long-ago animals became dogs, and some fish, and others men. So the animals are
          really our cousins, and that is why we should be kind to them. The story of how we began is really the most exciting story in the world, and this is only a little bit of it. The full story
          is very long and difficult, but the parts in this book are quite easy, and I hope you will like them. Then when you are big you can learn the rest. - J. B. S. Haldane

title: How Pranav Went to School
author: Nandini Nayar
description:
Little Pranav is going to school for the first time. Read this touching story to experience the ocean of emotions that a child experiences before going to school. Endearing pictures
  rightly capture the many moods of Pranav.

title: How Old is Muttajji?
author: Roopa Rai
description:
Putta and Putti know that Muttajji is really, really old. But exactly HOW old is she? Join the twin detectives on an exciting mathematical journey through Muttajji's memories and
  India's history in their quest to crack the big question.

title: How Many?
author: Sudeshna Shome Ghosh
description: Crawling snails, fluttering butterflies, pigs in the mud. This book has so many animals, and more keep joining in. Can you count them all? A simple book about addition.

title: How I Like My Rain
author: Salil Chaturvedi
description: The world has come to a standstill, and the water is telling many tales. Won't you open this book and listen to the singing rain?

title: How Does the Toothpaste Get into the Tube?
author: Veena Prasad
description: Squeezing out the toothpaste from the tube every morning is simple. But do you know how it got into the tube? Let's tell you how?

title: Household Stories
author: Brothers Grimm
description:
Classic stories include "Rumpelstiltskin," "Rapunzel," "Hansel and Gretel," "The Fisherman and his Wife," "Snow White," "Tom Thumb," "Sleeping Beauty," "Cinderella," and so many
  more. Lavishly illustrated with original 19th-century drawings by Walter Crane.

title: Hot Tea and Warm Rugs
author: Mala Kumar, Priya Kuriyan, Manisha Chaudhry
description:
Meenu's smart winter uniforms are out and the air is filled with the aroma of roasted nuts. Not to forget a cloud of mist in from of her mouth while she speaks! Let us find out what
  is happening this winter.

title: Hope, Where are you for Kate?
author: Armand Doucet, Elisa Guerra
keywords: Hope, Where are you for Kate?
description: The schools are closed and Kate from America is bored and wants the attention of her family. They are busy. What does she do next?

title: Hop Jo-Jo Hop
author: Janaki Sooriyarachchi
description: They laughed at little Jo-Jo, because he couldn't hop the way they could.

title: History of Old Mother Goose and her son Jack
author: Joseph Martin Kronheim

title: Hippo Wants to Dance
author: Sam Beckbessinger, Marisa Steyn, Megan Andrews
description: Hippo wants to dance. Won’t anyone dance with her?

title: Hide and Seek
author: Kanchan Bannerjee
description: When you play Hide and Seek with your friends, where do YOU hide? Want some ideas? Let's read this story.

title: Hey Diddle Diddle and Baby Bunting
author: Randolph Caldecott
keywords: Hey Diddle Diddle and Baby Bunting
description:
One of a series of classic Victorian children's books by the British artist and author. Caldecott was the eponym of the Caldecott Medal and transformed the world of children's books
  in the Victorian era. He exercised his art chiefly in book illustrations, which were full of life, and instinct with a kindly, graceful humour. The stories and rhymes were all of his choosing and
  in some cases were written or added to by himself.

title: Hero of the Mountain
author: Ivan Parvov
description: Bubu the fox travels to see a contest 'The Hero of the Mountain' along the way he learns what it means to be a true hero.

title: Here be dragons
author: Nick Creech
description:
The adventures of Welsh twins, recruited by a small dragon for an important task, travelling back to the time of Merlin and the Knights of the Round Table. A fantasy tale featuring
  Welsh and folk history.

title: Hen and Eagle
author: Ann Nduku
description: At one time, Hen and Eagle were good friends. Then Hen borrows a needle from Eagle, and the needle is lost. Eagle is so angry that she wants a terrible revenge.

title: Hello
author: Jennie Marima
description: Lolo has many lovely friends. They are Sun and Moon and Star and Bird too. She would love to introduce them to you.

title: Hare tricks Elephant again
author: Agnes Gachaba, Ursula Nafula
description: In this story we learn why the hare is such a fast runner and how he tricked his friend the elephant with a cruel joke.

title: Harding's Luck
author: E. Nesbit
description: A time travel fantasy where a young Dickie Harding discovers magic and bumps into the Ardens.

title: Handbook for Writers of Children’s Books
author: Unknown
description:
The present Handbook is a direct outcome of the lessons learned in the Tanzania and Uganda workshops. It is hoped that it will reach a much wider audience than the workshops were
  able to address, and thus disseminate the knowledge and skills generated in the training for the benefit of writers from other countries. The Handbook does not pretend to provide a detailed and
  comprehensive guide, but aims to present some basic principles that should be taken into account when writing for children.

title: Gurru and Peechu's Day Out
author: Meenu Thomas
description: Gurru and Peechu have nowhere to play! Join them as they go scouting for new spaces in their city.

title: Guess What I'm Doing!
author: Unknown
description:
"Books are a joy no child should be denied." This beautiful book produced by ACCU (Asian Cultural Centre for UNESCO) in co-operation with UNESCO on the occasion of International
  Literacy Year, will enchant children by introducing them to the many cultures and people all round the world.

title: Grandpa’s Gold
author: Kerry Saadien-Raad, Mathilde de Blois, Elsabé Milandri
description:
The children are talking about their grandpas. Giraffe’s grandpa can build a skyscraper. Elephant’s grandpa can cook a massive feast. But whose grandpa will give the children the
  biggest surprise?

title: Grandpa Fish and the Radio
author: Venkatramana Gowda
description:
The fish family had a grand old radio in their living room, but the young ones never let poor Grandpa Fish ever get near it, so busy were they listening to it themselves.
          Until one day, Grandpa Fish insisted on hearing the news, and heard a very important announcement indeed...

title: Grandma's Glasses
author: Noni
description: Grandma loses her glasses all the time. Sometimes she needs a smart detective to find them for her!

title: Graca's Dream
author: Melissa Fagan
description: The inspiring story of Graca Machel, and her dream to instill a love for reading and learning in the children of Mozambique and the rest of Africa.

title: Goplu's Train Ride
author: E. Gordan Browne
description: Goplu is excited to ride on the train with Thammi, who has lots of friends and a smile for every one. Maybe today Goplu can make a friend too.

title: Goodnight, Tinku !
author: Preethi Nambiar
description: Tinku, a little pup at Mangu's farm is not sleepy at all. He decides to step out into the night and meets many interesting animals.

title: Going to the City
author: Lesley Koyi, Ursula Nafula
description: A boy is visiting the City for the first time. How do you think his sights on the way will be?

title: Going to a Wedding
author: Rukmini Banerji
description: Children always like to share their experience with others. 'Going to a Wedding' shows how enjoyable the experiences can be.

title: Going to a Market
author: Meera Tendolkar
description: Children always like to share their experience with others. 'Going to a Market' shows how enjoyable the experiences can be.

title: Going to Buy a Book
author: Rukmini Banerji
description: Children always like to share their experience with others. 'Going to Buy a Book' shows how enjoyable these experiences can be.

title: Goat, Dog and Cow
author: Fabian Wakholi
description:
Goat, Dog and Cow are good friends. They take a trip together on a taxi, but when the time comes to pay the driver one of the friends does something surprising. And as a result of
  what happened, each animal develops a different reaction to motor vehicles.

title: Gems from Mother Goose
author: McLoughlin Bros
description: A collection of familiar rhymes such as "Humpty-Dumpty", "Dingty Diddledy", "Wee Willie Winkie", and others

title: Gecko on the Wall
author: Danielle Bruckert
description: A short book about geckos around the house using rhyme and imagination. Suitable for reading to pre-school children, or reading by children learning to read.

title: Gandhi: A Biography for Children and Beginners
author: Ravindra Varma
keywords: A Biography for Children and Beginners
description:
The book is the first volume in three that talks about a narrative on the life of Gandhi. This small book is meant to serve as an introduction, particularly for the benefit of
  children and persons interested in learning about Gandhi.

title: Fun Early Readers Collection (Volume I)
author: Danielle Bruckert
description:
Four of our Early readers in one easy to download file. This book contains Supercow, Gecko on the Wall, Bugs by Numbers, and Writing on the Wall. These books are aimed at
  Kindergarten and Pre-Kindergarten children, but also great for first grades learning to read.

title: Fruit
author: Shakira Bodio
description:
There was a beautiful girl whom everyone wished to marry. In her family compound, there was a tree with delicious fruit. Her parents decided that their daughter would marry whoever
  visited them and stayed the whole day without eating any of the fruit. Who would pass?

title: Frog's Democracy [A Collection of Child Stories]
author: Kartikeya Ghimire

title: Friends become enemies
author: Kennedy Amandu
description: Will hardworking Hyena ever learn his lesson when it comes to his friend the lazy Hare?

title: Foxy Joxy Plays a Trick
author: Nahida Esmail
description: Foxy Joxy, a sly fox, sells watermelons. One day he has a clever idea. The animals were not happy. What will they do to teach him a lesson?

title: For The Win
author: Cory Doctorow
description:
The book is centered around massively multiplayer online role-playing games. Even though the novel is targeted toward young adults, it takes on significant concepts such as
          macroeconomics and labor rights. It covers the new and fast evolving concept of virtual economy. It also deals with MMORPG specific topics like gold farming and
          power-leveling.

title: Folk Tales from Nepal
author: Kayomars Bilimoria Puri
description: The book contains 9 folktales of Nepal adapted from the book, “The King Who Rides a Tiger: and other Folk Tales from Nepal” by Patricia Hitchcock.

title: Flying through the Land of Wonders
author: Kartikeya Ghimire

title: Flying High
author: Vidya Tiware
